description: This file defines the PageSetup class responsible for parsing and applying page setup configurations such as margins, orientation, paper size, headers, footers, and page breaks from an XML representation within the PhpSpreadsheet library for XLSX files.

classes.name: PageSetup
classes.description: Handles parsing and applying page setup settings from an XML element for a worksheet, including margins, headers, footers, page orientation, size, breaks, and related attributes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the PageSetup object with a worksheet and optionally an XML representation of the worksheet details.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads page setup configurations from the XML into the worksheet, updating margins, page setup, headers/footers, and page breaks.

methods.name: margins
methods.description: Applies page margins settings from XML to the worksheet.

methods.name: pageSetup
methods.description: Applies page layout settings such as orientation, paper size, scale, fit to height/width, first page number, and page order from XML to the worksheet.

methods.name: headerFooter
methods.description: Configures header and footer settings for the worksheet based on XML data.

methods.name: pageBreaks
methods.description: Handles page breaks in rows and columns based on XML.

methods.name: rowBreaks
methods.description: Sets row page breaks as specified in XML.

methods.name: columnBreaks
methods.description: Sets column page breaks as specified in XML.
